purpose: Exact ordinary causal reference with multiple missing events and explicit finite generator uncertainty; no analytic core advantage claim
holdout_role: Development until source is published before first materialization; immutable publication may qualify fixed bounded new-world verification, not general architecture confirmation
missing_mechanism: Choose exactly m prelude positions uniformly independently of event contents; complete binding bridges remain supplied
read: Choose one missing causal index, retrieve its actual typed owner token, condition at original position; charge mean-four-key utility fee; hidden true labels never enter control
known_policy: READ iff maximum exact expected mean-key accuracy gain exceeds fee, then argmax posterior per key
unknown_policy: Within explicit two-generator set, select READ iff minimum model gain exceeds fee; answer only when model argmax agree and minimum model probability >= 0.8; otherwise abstain

criteria.exact_reference: Full independent tiny-world enumeration marginals and evidence max abs error <= 2e-12; READ conditionals <= 2e-12
criteria.support: Known-law true target posterior positive on every key before and after actual READ; missing positions preserve marginalized distractor hypotheses
criteria.read: No known-law actual READ zero likelihood; all costs and mismatched-model failures counted
criteria.scope: Four symbolic addresses/eight labels, 2 or 3 missing tokens, known finite support and complete symbolic alias map; no real AV or semantic learning
